overloads.semanticRole: Sets the data context of a sheet from a single Object, bound to worksheet cells via autogeneration or VP SET BINDING PATH.

discriminatedBy.rule: Chosen when the caller supplies the context data as a single Object (attribute-per-cell binding rather than row/column generation).

overloads.semanticRole: Sets the data context of a sheet from a Collection, optionally autogenerating row/column layout from its contents.

discriminatedBy.rule: Chosen when the caller supplies the context data as a Collection, enabling the autoGenerateColumns row/column-generation behavior.

constraints: Images placed in the data are converted to data URI schemes.
To pass a time value in dataObj/dataColl, encapsulate it in an object with a 'value' property (the base value) and a 'time' property (Real, time in seconds).
options.reset (default False) resets the sheet's contents before loading the new context.

options.autoGenerateColumns (default True) only applies when the data is a collection: if dataColl is a collection of objects, attribute names become column titles; if dataColl contains subcollections of scalar values, each subcollection defines one row's values and the first subcollection's length determines the number of columns created.
If no sheet index is passed, the context is applied to the current sheet.
